source_provenance.fixed_parent_files: R757 curved profile, delayed curved metric and rectifying/nonflat-cap physical geometry are three explicit frozen files. R752 supplies the delayed turning law. All original R740/742/744/746/747/748 utilities, profile nodes, Run40 residual/metric helpers, and as-published Run42 terminal mesh algorithms are selected by immutable identity. R759 supplies the additional physical paired-track inputs. The R757 inputs were independently read at 0481a16fa180ef7d977814267edd981ac330f4ab.
source_provenance.scientific_observations: All ten fresh starts use the same unmodified R757 reference. Neither family requires Run42 coordinates or physical fields. The seven shifted and three paired starts have separate winners and separate complete terminal outputs on one worker.

physics.shape: True R757 metric on every point of both nonflat caps, curved profiles with original straight cells bowed, both complete three-vector rolls, exact rectifying central, six independent rigid motions per cap and optional paid fan directions. Includes both clamped fractional powers and three independent curved-wall atoms at distinct phase shifts. Three additional R759 paired-curvature motions keep the entire R757 elliptic rim sign. The paired refinement adds independent three-vector polynomial coefficients over each entire filled cap, two free poses, all previous roll directions and an exact strong central track angle. Shift and paired winners each receive all 4/8/16 intervals and the entire terminal export.
physics.shooting_discretization: Well-balanced perturbation about the actual naked geometric field (R759 phase curvature for the paired design, original section for the shifted design), using its exact Jacobi field at all RK substeps, full nonlinear metric/Christoffel/Gaussian table differences, 32769+ one-dimensional curvature nodes, exact R752 delayed radial jets per stage, plus independently returned original bilinear calibration. Fixed target is always k0.

scientific_budget.solver: L-BFGS-B with maxls=24, maxcor=15, ftol=2e-12, gtol=2e-8; all phase-zero and positive-time coordinates retained. The independent check uses RK4 on the complete union of physical nodes and its specified steps.
scientific_budget.closure: 65 final fixed-metric time checks plus all seven listed world mesh phases; finite comparisons use their union, including any noncoincident export angles. No wall-clock convergence predicate.
scientific_budget.independent_finalists: Ten coarse designs (seven original and three paired) plus the full three refinements for each independently selected winner = 16 scientific stages. Both fixed closed points receive the seven original PLY exports and the full union of checked phases.

mathematics: R757 supplies the common curved-profile, nonflat-cap target. The original seven starts and three R759 paired-track candidates are all solved. The new family changes the central curvature tracks and follows the true physical end geometry. Every family winner receives its independent three full same-metric space/time refinements and full terminal mesh comparisons on the very same worker. Finite right-tensor errors, guarded shooting and sampled nonfocality, embedding, support and moment measurements remain numerical. The nonzero-curvature feature alone does not establish the global target, uniform reach or noncongruence. The reference-balanced physical shooting equations and perturbation interpolation run on the updated grid. The published stages also return the original unbalanced bare-state calibration for comparison.
